name: Marching Tetrahedra Reconstruction
definition: A surface reconstruction method that converts a set of input vertices and normals into a 3D mesh by computing an implicit field using the Welland function, sampling it on a tetrahedral grid, and extracting the zero-level set via Marching Tetrahedra.
summary: Marching Tetrahedra Reconstruction converts vertices and normals into a 3D mesh using a Welland-based implicit field on a tetrahedral grid, eliminating the ambiguity cases inherent in standard Marching Cubes.
